column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 20 (M23020): Mokosh jatuh; The Elmo bersembunyi di Collapse Storm.
# Tetap Inggris: Lentine, Lisa, Kenny, Groza, Mayling, Helen, Mokosh, Mangi Security,
# The Elmo, Doll Community, Collapse Storm, Yellow Zone, Doll.
# Catatan: satu baris di file Inggris masih berbahasa Mandarin (bunyi alarm).
(The battle in Mokosh was drawing to a close. With Mangi Security's rapid advance into Mokosh, between death and surrender, the vast majority of people had already chosen to surrender.)
column2: (Pertempuran di Mokosh mendekati akhir. Dengan Mangi Security yang melaju cepat masuk ke Mokosh, di antara mati dan menyerah, sebagian besar orang sudah memilih menyerah.)

column1: (All civilians hid indoors, and the remaining resistance forces were well within the scope of what Mangi Security could handle. The fruits of victory were already within reach, yet the anger in Lentine's heart stubbornly refused to subside.)
column2: (Semua warga sipil bersembunyi di dalam rumah, dan sisa pasukan perlawanan masih jauh dalam batas kemampuan Mangi Security. Buah kemenangan sudah di depan mata, tapi amarah di hati Lentine keras kepala tak mau reda.)

column1: (After immediately handing over most of the control to the military, Lentine devoted more of her energy to tracking down the Commander's whereabouts.)
column2: (Setelah langsung menyerahkan sebagian besar kendali kepada militer, Lentine mencurahkan lebih banyak tenaganya untuk melacak keberadaan Komandan.)

column1: How is Kenny doing?
column2: Bagaimana keadaan Kenny?

column1: Still in emergency rescue...
column2: Masih dalam pertolongan darurat...

column1: But please don't hold out too much hope, sir...
column2: Tapi tolong jangan terlalu berharap, Bu...

column1: With a wound like that, it's a miracle to be alive.
column2: Dengan luka seperti itu, bisa hidup saja sudah keajaiban.

column1: Lisa, I want him to live, no matter what method.
column2: Lisa, aku ingin dia hidup, apa pun caranya.

column1: There must be some special technology... money and resources are not a problem, think of a way.
column2: Pasti ada teknologi khusus... uang dan sumber daya bukan masalah, cari jalannya.

column1: Even if it's a special method... we have to find a way to save him.
column2: Sekalipun harus dengan cara khusus... kita harus mencari cara menyelamatkannya.

column1: But...
column2: Tapi...

column1: (Lisa hesitated to speak, and when she saw the expression on Lentine's face, she realized that she absolutely shouldn't say too much at this time.)
column2: (Lisa ragu untuk bicara, dan saat melihat ekspresi di wajah Lentine, dia sadar sama sekali tidak boleh banyak bicara saat ini.)

column1: Yes, Commander Lentine, I will do my best.
column2: Baik, Komandan Lentine, saya akan berusaha sebisa mungkin.

column1: (Suddenly losing the adjutant by her side, the anger in Lentine's heart could not subside for a long time. It was a hatred that could only be repaid with the enemy's flesh and blood.)
column2: (Mendadak kehilangan ajudan di sisinya, amarah di hati Lentine tak kunjung reda. Itu kebencian yang hanya bisa dibayar dengan darah daging musuh.)

column1: (The figure of that person flashed through Lentine's mind. Among those Dolls who generously went to their deaths, there must be many of the other party's "property".)
column2: (Sosok orang itu berkelebat di benak Lentine. Di antara para Doll yang dengan rela menyongsong kematian itu, pasti banyak yang merupakan "milik" orang tersebut.)

column1: (After conquering Mokosh, what Lentine cared about was not the struggle for political power, but the belonging of that person.)
column2: (Setelah menaklukkan Mokosh, yang dipedulikan Lentine bukan perebutan kekuasaan politik, melainkan ke mana orang itu berlabuh.)

column1: Adjutant Lentine, we've tracked down the whereabouts of the enemy you mentioned.
column2: Ajudan Lentine, kami sudah melacak keberadaan musuh yang Anda sebut.

column1: Intelligence shows that last night a Doll squad broke out from the Mokosh tunnel and escaped under the cover of external companions.
column2: Informasi menunjukkan semalam satu regu Doll menerobos keluar dari terowongan Mokosh dan lolos di bawah perlindungan rekan-rekan dari luar.

column1: At that time, the squad was protecting a human casualty. Through the recovered video records, we confirmed that the human is that Commander.
column2: Saat itu regu tersebut melindungi seorang korban manusia. Lewat rekaman video yang berhasil dipulihkan, kami memastikan manusia itu adalah Komandan tersebut.

column1: And according to the current ground troops' report, the enemy base vehicle that remained silent last night suddenly drove into the outskirts, attempting to destroy our front line.
column2: Dan menurut laporan pasukan darat saat ini, kendaraan markas musuh yang semalam diam saja tiba-tiba melaju ke pinggiran, berusaha menghancurkan garis depan kita.

column1: Judging from the combat style, it is highly likely that that person is currently commanding on The Elmo.
column2: Dari gaya bertempurnya, sangat mungkin orang itu saat ini sedang memimpin dari Elmo.

column1: Heh... Relieving Mokosh's firepower by assaulting the rear, it indeed seems like his style.
column2: Heh... Meringankan tekanan tembakan pada Mokosh dengan menyerbu barisan belakang, itu memang khas gayanya.

column1: Have the elite troops strike immediately, counterattack The Elmo, and make sure to capture the enemy alive.
column2: Suruh pasukan elite bergerak sekarang juga, balas serang Elmo, dan pastikan musuhnya ditangkap hidup-hidup.

column1: (After The Elmo broke into the enemy's periphery and attracted several waves of attacks, the enemy's offensive against The Elmo gradually slowed down.)
column2: (Setelah Elmo menerobos ke pinggiran musuh dan memancing beberapa gelombang serangan, serangan musuh terhadap Elmo perlahan melambat.)

column1: (Groza took the opportunity to command The Elmo to retreat from the battlefield, and the Dolls, whose energy was nearly depleted, also successively returned to rest.)
column2: (Groza memanfaatkan kesempatan itu untuk memerintahkan Elmo mundur dari medan tempur, dan para Doll yang energinya nyaris terkuras pun berangsur kembali untuk beristirahat.)

column1: (However, despite achieving many results on the ground battlefield, the battle situation in the underground city is still worrying—)
column2: (Namun, meski banyak hasil diraih di medan tempur permukaan, situasi pertempuran di kota bawah tanah tetap mengkhawatirkan—)

column1: Captain, Mokosh, there's completely no signal...
column2: Kapten, Mokosh, sama sekali tidak ada sinyal...

column1: I contacted all the squads, and communication couldn't connect either. Is everyone, is everyone...
column2: Aku menghubungi semua regu, komunikasinya juga tidak tersambung. Apa semuanya, apa semuanya...

column1: (Mayling didn't continue speaking, just with red eyes, tightly clenching her fists.)
column2: (Mayling tidak melanjutkan ucapannya, hanya dengan mata memerah mengepalkan tinjunya erat-erat.)

column1: (Groza was silent for a moment, then reached out and patted Mayling's shoulder.)
column2: (Groza terdiam sejenak, lalu mengulurkan tangan menepuk bahu Mayling.)

column1: Mayling, no matter what, we can't stop now.
column2: Mayling, apa pun yang terjadi, kita tidak boleh berhenti sekarang.

column1: If the worst-case scenario has already happened, the enemy will soon turn their targets to the remaining forces on the battlefield.
column2: Kalau kemungkinan terburuk sudah terjadi, musuh akan segera mengalihkan sasarannya ke sisa pasukan di medan tempur.

column1: Before they arrive, we must evacuate the Commander to a safe place as soon as possible. The Elmo and everyone else need to rest and regroup.
column2: Sebelum mereka tiba, kita harus secepatnya memindahkan Komandan ke tempat aman. Elmo dan semua orang butuh istirahat dan menata ulang barisan.

column1: Woo... mhm! So next, is The Elmo going back to the Doll Community?
column2: Hiks... mhm! Jadi selanjutnya, Elmo akan kembali ke Doll Community?

column1: Yes. However, we can't evacuate with great fanfare—
column2: Ya. Tapi kita tidak bisa menyingkir dengan mencolok—

column1: (Beep beep beep beep beep—)
column2: (Bip bip bip bip bip—)

column1: (The blaring alarm interrupted Groza's words. Mayling urgently maneuvered to block the airstrike missiles, and quickly brought up the reconnaissance drone.)
column2: (Sirene yang meraung memotong ucapan Groza. Mayling buru-buru bermanuver menahan rudal serangan udara, dan cepat memanggil drone pengintai.)

column1: (In the footage, in the wilderness not far away, several well-equipped and well-trained teams were moving rapidly against the flow of people towards The Elmo.)
column2: (Dalam rekamannya, di padang tandus tak jauh dari sana, beberapa tim berperlengkapan lengkap dan terlatih bergerak cepat melawan arus orang menuju Elmo.)

column1: Captain, they, they're chasing us!
column2: Kapten, mereka, mereka mengejar kita!

column1: Mhm... as expected, they won't easily give up on The Elmo. But, we can't let them chase us to the community either.
column2: Mhm... sesuai dugaan, mereka tidak akan gampang melepaskan Elmo. Tapi kita juga tidak boleh membiarkan mereka mengejar kita sampai ke community.

column1: Captain, what should we do? After the battle just now, everyone's ammunition is running low...
column2: Kapten, kita harus bagaimana? Setelah pertempuran tadi, amunisi semua orang sudah menipis...

column1: (Groza pondered for a moment.)
column2: (Groza termenung sejenak.)

column1: (Afterward, she quickly tapped the screen until a weather status map of the nearby area appeared before her.)
column2: (Setelah itu dia cepat mengetuk layar sampai peta status cuaca kawasan sekitar terpampang di depannya.)

column1: (On the map, several areas marked in red were particularly striking.)
column2: (Di peta itu, beberapa area bertanda merah sangat mencolok.)

column1: Mayling, how confident are you if we pilot The Elmo into the Collapse Storm to take cover?
column2: Mayling, seberapa yakin kau kalau kita membawa Elmo masuk ke Collapse Storm untuk berlindung?

column1: Captain, you want to use the Collapse Storm to hide our tracks on the radar?
column2: Kapten, Anda mau memakai Collapse Storm untuk menyembunyikan jejak kita dari radar?

column1: I can, but... the wear and tear... ugh...
column2: Aku bisa, tapi... kerusakannya... ugh...

column1: Let's do it! I'll repair the wear and tear on The Elmo!
column2: Ayo kita lakukan! Kerusakan Elmo biar aku yang perbaiki!

column1: Under the current situation, this is the best way to completely shake off the enemy.
column2: Dalam situasi sekarang, ini cara terbaik untuk benar-benar melepaskan diri dari musuh.

column1: However... the other party's target is obviously The Elmo, they won't easily retreat just because they encounter a storm.
column2: Tapi... sasaran mereka jelas Elmo, mereka tidak akan gampang mundur cuma karena bertemu badai.

column1: It's okay, Mayling. If you're worried, I'll personally pilot The Elmo.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, Mayling. Kalau kau cemas, aku sendiri yang akan mengemudikan Elmo.

column1: No! I can do it! In case the enemy catches up, the Captain still has to continue commanding.
column2: Tidak! Aku bisa! Kalau-kalau musuh menyusul, Kapten masih harus terus memimpin.

column1: Leave the driving to me! I-I will try my best to reduce the numbers on the repair bill!
column2: Urusan menyetir serahkan padaku! A-Aku akan berusaha sebisa mungkin menekan angka di tagihan perbaikannya!

column1: (Mayling took a deep breath, rubbed her hands together, and sat back down in front of the console.)
column2: (Mayling menarik napas dalam, menggosok kedua tangannya, lalu duduk kembali di depan konsol.)

column1: (With her manipulation, the engine let out a loud roar, and The Elmo accelerated towards the barren wilderness.)
column2: (Di bawah kendalinya, mesin itu meraung keras, dan Elmo melaju kencang ke arah padang tandus.)

column1: (And the several squads closely following behind, as expected, immediately accelerated, closely pursuing The Elmo deep into the wilderness.)
column2: (Dan beberapa regu yang membuntuti di belakang, sesuai dugaan, langsung mempercepat laju, mengejar rapat Elmo sampai jauh ke dalam padang tandus.)

column1: (In the wilderness, the team led by Lentine and the military's team constantly approached The Elmo.)
column2: (Di padang tandus itu, tim pimpinan Lentine dan tim militer terus mendekati Elmo.)

column1: (Even though the Elmo would strike back with Dolls every time the distance closed, several squads persistently tailed behind.)
column2: (Meski Elmo selalu membalas dengan mengerahkan para Doll setiap kali jaraknya menyempit, beberapa regu tetap gigih membuntuti.)

column1: All squads, continue accelerating! Once close, attack the chassis and engine area to cut off their possibility of escape!
column2: Seluruh regu, terus percepat! Begitu dekat, serang bagian sasis dan mesinnya untuk memutus peluang mereka kabur!

column1: Adjutant Lentine, intelligence shows that a storm is moving toward the target's direction of advance.
column2: Ajudan Lentine, informasi menunjukkan ada badai bergerak ke arah laju sasaran.

column1: If we cannot catch up to him before the storm arrives, give up the pursuit.
column2: Kalau kita tidak bisa menyusulnya sebelum badai tiba, hentikan pengejaran.

column1: With such resolve, you won't be able to catch that person.
column2: Dengan tekad setipis itu, kau tidak akan bisa menangkap orang itu.

column1: To be able to leave Mokosh without being tracked, besides taking the underground passage, the only way is to find a way to go to an undetectable area.
column2: Untuk bisa meninggalkan Mokosh tanpa terlacak, selain lewat lorong bawah tanah, satu-satunya cara adalah mencari jalan ke area yang tak terdeteksi.

column1: Entering the Collapse Storm... is enough to shake off all pursuit.
column2: Masuk ke Collapse Storm... itu cukup untuk melepaskan diri dari semua pengejaran.

column1: We have no need to follow the enemy into the storm area.
column2: Kita tidak perlu mengikuti musuh masuk ke area badai.

column1: As long as the Collapse Storm ends, we can still find their tracks after the enemy appears.
column2: Asal Collapse Storm-nya berakhir, kita tetap bisa menemukan jejak mereka begitu musuh muncul.

column1: What if they don't come out?
column2: Bagaimana kalau mereka tidak keluar?

column1: If they keep hiding in the Collapse Storm, our supplies won't hold out. Besides, it's impossible to monitor all enemy movements, we only have this one chance. No matter what, I'll track them to the end.
column2: Kalau mereka terus bersembunyi di Collapse Storm, perbekalan kita tidak akan sanggup. Lagi pula mustahil memantau semua gerakan musuh, kita cuma punya satu kesempatan ini. Apa pun yang terjadi, akan kulacak mereka sampai akhir.

column1: A Collapse Storm... let's see who can survive this round.
column2: Collapse Storm... mari kita lihat siapa yang bisa selamat di ronde ini.

column1: (Soon, The Elmo, like a fearless beast, charged straight towards the direction of the storm, and the Mangi Security squad led by Lentine also followed The Elmo's figure and rushed into the storm area.)
column2: (Tak lama, Elmo bagai binatang buas tanpa takut menerjang lurus ke arah badai, dan regu Mangi Security pimpinan Lentine pun mengikuti sosok Elmo dan menerobos masuk ke area badai.)

column1: (Only the military's team remained on the periphery of the storm area.)
column2: (Hanya tim militer yang tetap tinggal di pinggiran area badai.)

column1: （嘀嘀嘀嘀嘀嘀——）
column2: （Bip bip bip bip bip bip——）

column1: (The detection device had already lost its sensitivity under the influence of strong collapse radiation, and the alarm was constantly sounding, giving people an infinite sense of oppression.)
column2: (Perangkat deteksinya sudah kehilangan kepekaan akibat radiasi collapse yang kuat, dan sirenenya terus meraung, menimbulkan rasa tertekan tanpa henti.)

column1: (After Mangi Security's troops broke into the storm area, what greeted them was not only strong collapse radiation, but also continuous artillery attacks.)
column2: (Setelah pasukan Mangi Security menerobos masuk ke area badai, yang menyambut mereka bukan cuma radiasi collapse yang kuat, tapi juga gempuran artileri tanpa henti.)

column1: Oh no, the front and periphery are under attack. Our radar is in an unstable state, making it difficult to locate the enemy.
column2: Gawat, bagian depan dan pinggiran diserang. Radar kita dalam kondisi tidak stabil, sulit menentukan posisi musuh.

column1: (Front, left, right... under the cover of the Collapse storm, artillery fire from the base vehicle attacked again and again.)
column2: (Depan, kiri, kanan... di balik tabir Collapse Storm, tembakan artileri dari kendaraan markas itu menyerang berkali-kali.)

column1: (In the armored convoy, one vehicle seemed to be anchored by enemy artillery fire. It was attacked several times in an instant, and the damaged vehicle body suddenly burst under the impact. The blazing fire suddenly scattered the neat formation around it.)
column2: (Dalam iring-iringan lapis baja itu, satu kendaraan seakan terkunci tembakan artileri musuh. Dalam sekejap dia dihantam berkali-kali, dan bodinya yang rusak mendadak meledak akibat hantaman itu. Api yang berkobar seketika mencerai-beraikan formasi rapi di sekitarnya.)

column1: (Amidst the Collapse Storm, the bursting explosives penetrated the land swept up by smoke and dust, directly damaging the enemy's tank.)
column2: (Di tengah Collapse Storm, bahan peledak yang meletus menembus tanah yang tersapu asap dan debu, langsung merusak tank musuh.)

column1: Everyone concentrate, don't separate!
column2: Semuanya berkumpul, jangan terpisah!

column1: Advance in a grid formation.
column2: Maju dalam formasi kotak.

column1: (In the Collapse Storm, The Elmo's portholes creaked. Fine dust and sand violently beat against the glass with the hurricane. Strong electromagnetic interference made the signals inside the vehicle difficult to distinguish. Countless alarms were triggered, and then manually turned off one by one by Groza.)
column2: (Di dalam Collapse Storm, jendela bundar Elmo berderit. Debu dan pasir halus menghantam keras kacanya bersama badai. Gangguan elektromagnetik yang kuat membuat sinyal di dalam kendaraan sulit dibedakan. Sirene tak terhitung ikut menyala, lalu satu per satu dimatikan Groza secara manual.)

column1: Mayling, can you still hold on?
column2: Mayling, kau masih sanggup?

column1: N-N-No problem...!
column2: T-T-Tidak masalah...!

column1: (Mayling gritted her teeth and controlled the engine, while Groza beside her commanded the Dolls to conduct harassing actions near various covers outside The Elmo.)
column2: (Mayling mengertakkan gigi sambil mengendalikan mesin, sementara Groza di sebelahnya memerintahkan para Doll melancarkan aksi pengganggu di dekat berbagai perlindungan di luar Elmo.)

column1: Cover spotted ahead. All squads outside the vehicle, attention, place signal decoys immediately!
column2: Terlihat perlindungan di depan. Seluruh regu di luar kendaraan, perhatian, segera pasang umpan sinyal!

column1: (Despite the raging storm, the Dolls fighting outside the vehicle did not hesitate for a moment. They neatly scattered into the endless yellow sand, moving with difficulty against the storm.)
column2: (Meski badai mengamuk, para Doll yang bertempur di luar kendaraan tidak ragu sedetik pun. Mereka menyebar rapi ke dalam hamparan pasir kuning tanpa ujung, bergerak susah payah melawan badai.)

column1: (On the other side of the command console, Helen also followed Groza's instructions, constantly placing false signal decoys through the radar.)
column2: (Di sisi lain konsol komando, Helen juga mengikuti arahan Groza, terus memasang umpan sinyal palsu lewat radar.)

column1: (Riding the Collapse Storm, several false and intermittent signals were broadcast in all directions, appearing in scattered, free-floating irregular forms, constantly interfering with the enemy's judgment ability.)
column2: (Menunggangi Collapse Storm, beberapa sinyal palsu yang putus-putus disiarkan ke segala arah, muncul dalam bentuk tak beraturan yang tersebar dan melayang bebas, terus mengacaukan kemampuan musuh menilai keadaan.)

column1: (And in this collapsing world of flying sand and rolling stones, the lurking Dolls hid among the virtual signal traps, waiting for the arrival of their prey—)
column2: (Dan di dunia yang runtuh dengan pasir beterbangan dan batu berguling ini, para Doll yang mengintai bersembunyi di antara jebakan sinyal maya itu, menanti kedatangan mangsa mereka—)

column1: (The dust kicked up by the Collapse Storm had reduced the visibility in this area again and again.)
column2: (Debu yang diterbangkan Collapse Storm terus-menerus memperburuk jarak pandang di kawasan itu.)

column1: (With the radar failing, Lentine could even only rely on the source of the enemy's attacks to judge the enemy's direction.)
column2: (Dengan radar yang tidak berfungsi, Lentine bahkan hanya bisa mengandalkan sumber serangan musuh untuk menebak arah mereka.)

column1: (The other party split into two teams—no, maybe three teams... Mangi Security was like a giant beast falling into the water, struggling to search for the enemy's whereabouts.)
column2: (Pihak lawan terpecah jadi dua tim—bukan, mungkin tiga tim... Mangi Security bagai binatang raksasa yang tercebur ke air, megap-megap mencari keberadaan musuh.)

column1: Commander, the enemy has given up struggling! And the signals of two attack squads are approaching each other.
column2: Komandan, musuh sudah menyerah melawan! Dan sinyal dua regu penyerang saling mendekat.

column1: Prepare to capture—
column2: Bersiap menangkap—

column1: Wait!
column2: Tunggu!

column1: (Passing through the cover again, Lentine, getting closer to the enemy, saw the faintly visible scene behind the sandstorm... It wasn't The Elmo, but just the wreckage of a city ruin.)
column2: (Setelah kembali melewati perlindungan, Lentine yang makin dekat dengan musuh melihat pemandangan yang samar tampak di balik badai pasir... Itu bukan Elmo, melainkan hanya bangkai reruntuhan kota.)

column1: (An ominous premonition arose spontaneously.)
column2: (Firasat buruk muncul dengan sendirinya.)

column1: (The radiation detector suddenly started beeping wildly, followed closely by a sand-colored tornado right before our eyes—)
column2: (Detektor radiasi tiba-tiba meraung liar, disusul rapat oleh angin puting beliung berwarna pasir tepat di depan mata—)

column1: The Collapse storm has spread to this area!
column2: Collapse Storm sudah menyebar ke area ini!

column1: Everyone, make sure to put on your radiation suits and retreat immediately!
column2: Semuanya, pastikan memakai setelan anti-radiasi dan segera mundur!

column1: (Collapse Storm, the most common and dangerous natural disaster in the Yellow Zone. However, it is also a natural cover; no detection instruments can function within this range.)
column2: (Collapse Storm, bencana alam paling umum sekaligus paling berbahaya di Yellow Zone. Tapi ia juga tabir alami; tak ada instrumen deteksi yang bisa berfungsi dalam jangkauannya.)

column1: (Most importantly, this is an escape route The Elmo has rehearsed several times.)
column2: (Yang terpenting, ini jalur pelarian yang sudah beberapa kali dilatih Elmo.)

column1: (The constantly jumping numbers and striking dark red on the weather radar proved that this was not a small Collapse storm. Even with data support and previous rehearsals, Mayling still showed a trace of hesitation.)
column2: (Angka yang terus melonjak dan warna merah tua mencolok di radar cuaca membuktikan ini bukan Collapse Storm kecil. Meski ada dukungan data dan latihan-latihan sebelumnya, Mayling tetap menunjukkan segaris keraguan.)

column1: (But when her gaze swept over everyone on The Elmo, she immediately took a deep breath to adjust her mindset.)
column2: (Tapi saat pandangannya menyapu semua orang di Elmo, dia langsung menarik napas dalam untuk menata kembali pikirannya.)
